items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know Lester, Blackie? He plays snare drum. I've seen him in the streets. [INTERVIEWER] I think I do know him. Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, I remember Emanuel Perez and them. I don't remember the name of the band, but I mean, some of the players, you know, you should be in the band, old times. Buddy Madden and all of them, them days. Joe Oliver. Did you like any one of them the best? Anywhere music was, I just had liked music, you know? That's what I said. I started there. I didn't finish, though. I regret it that many did.
Did many piano players play parades? Let's see now. Santiago plays snare drum. I never thought about that too much. You know Lester, Blackie? He plays snare drum. I've seen him in the streets.
I think I do know him. Yeah.
